briefing: Markets were quietly mixed today with NASDAQ +0.6% and S&P 500 +0.3% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new positions were opened; existing holdings (including MU, which remains on today's top candidate list) are held as stop-loss and profit-target rules continue to manage them automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off doesn't always mean a market crash — it can simply mean conditions aren't compelling enough to justify new bets. When cash reserves are low and signals are mixed rather than strongly bullish, disciplined investors hold their existing positions and wait rather than force a trade just to stay 'active'.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）不一定代表市場暴跌，有時只是代表現時環境未足以支持開新倉。當現金水平偏低、市場訊號又非明顯偏多時，有紀律的投資者會選擇持有現有倉位、耐心等待，而非為求「有交易」而勉強出手。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted modestly higher today without a clear catalyst, reflecting a wait-and-see mood among investors rather than any decisive shift in sentiment. Trading volume and volatility stayed subdued, consistent with a market digesting recent gains rather than chasing new highs. With no strong risk-on signal and limited cash on hand, sitting tight was the more disciplined choice than forcing a trade.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢溫和上揚，NASDAQ升0.6%，標普500升0.3%，並無明顯的催化因素，反映投資者觀望氣氛較濃，而非市場情緒出現明顯轉向。成交量及波幅均維持平穩，顯示市場正在消化近期升幅，而非積極追高。由於缺乏明確的風險偏好訊號，加上現金水平有限，按兵不動較貿然入市更為審慎。
